title: K Closest Points to Origin
summary: Given points on a plane, return the k points nearest to the origin.

tests.explain: Squared distances are 18, 5 and 16. The point [1, -2] is the closest.
Squared distances are 8, 17, 9 and 26, so the two closest are [2, 2] (8) and [0, -3] (9). Any order is accepted.
The origin itself is at distance 0.

hints: Compare squared distances x² + y²: the order is the same as for the real distance, and you avoid Math.sqrt.
To keep the k smallest distances, keep a max-heap of size k: its top is the farthest of the current candidates, the one to throw out when a closer point arrives.
Push every point; whenever the heap holds k + 1 points, pop the farthest. What's left is the answer, in any order.

complexity.time: O(n log k): each point is pushed once and popped at most once on a heap of size k + 1
